note: All-ages full-hookup RV park on US-98 N north of Lakeland; reviews thin. Also sells indoor RV storage. The official site loads only over plain http (https serves an unrelated business's site). Park rules: one pet per site, no dogs over 35 lb. --Claude

Cleared the fees ($50-65): they were the prices of three NEARBY parks shown on the unclaimed RoverPass listing. Cleared booking reservable/platform roverpass (listing not bookable). Sites (86, 34 ft, pull-through) left as derived; the operator does not state them.
